page.overview:
What is Halloween Theme?

The "Halloween Theme" is the main theme music of the Halloween series.

The theme is written in the rare 5/4 time signature. Director John Carpenter composed the simple, chilling music as it was the first thing his father had taught him how to play on a piano.

The original theme features a simple piano music. Upper melody is based on a three note motif, using A root note and perfect 5th and a minor 6th. This motif starts in the key of F#minor while the bass melody moves slowly from F# up to A.

The next noticeable development is when the Bass the Moves up to Bb. Because as it ascends the upper melody transposes chromatically down a semitone to begin from F. Here the Bb, F, C, and Db suggest a Bb minor add9 chord.
